zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機3架次與共艦8艘 國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共機3架次與共艦8艘；3架次逾中線侵擾北部東部空域；國軍嚴密監控
body: 國防部於8月30日公布最新共機艦動態，統計自8月29日上午6時起至8月30日上午6時止，共偵獲8艘共艦、5艘公務船，以及3架次共機在台灣海峽周邊活動。其中3架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾台灣北部及東部空域。
針對共軍相關動態，國軍持續運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統，進行嚴密監控與應處。
根據本站統計紀錄，前一次於8月26日紀錄顯示，偵獲共機5架次、共艦6艘及公務船7艘。近30日紀錄中，共機單日最高紀錄為8月19日的15架次。

en.title: Taiwan MND Tracks 3 Chinese Aircraft and 8 Naval Vessels Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan MND tracked 3 Chinese aircraft crossing the median line and 8 naval vessels over 24 hours.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported that between 06:00 on August 29 and 06:00 on August 30, it detected eight Chinese military vessels, five official ships, and three Chinese military aircraft operating around Taiwan. The three aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait into northern and eastern airspace.
In response to the Chinese military activity, Taiwan's armed forces deployed task aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to monitor and respond to the movements.
According to site statistical records, the previous tracking record on August 26 registered five Chinese military aircraft, six military vessels, and seven official ships around Taiwan.
